candidates.statement: Payment service /v1/authorizations shows p95 ~4875ms while gateway checkout calls to payment fail with ReadTimeout (~2s), producing 502s at order and checkout. Payment still returns 200s, so it is slow rather than down; the timeout propagates as downstream latency.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment p95 4875ms exceeds the ~2s client timeout, but no payment-side span or log confirms where the latency originates (e.g., internal dependency).

report.explanation: Traces show checkout->order->payment failing with ReadTimeout on POST payment, yielding 502 at /v1/orders and /v1/checkout. Payment metrics show /v1/authorizations p95 ~4875ms with 200s still returned, consistent with downstream latency exceeding the ~2s client timeout. Inventory/redis calls succeed. Bounded to downstream-latency at payment.
